notes.title: 1.62测试版补丁
notes.content:
1.母巢的地图说明强化
2.修复生存模式开局刷金币的bug
3.修复印钞机升级成就没有解锁bug
4.修复虫子遁地的时候按时停，会出现多个洞 bug
4.修复炮台守卫模式可以开车出去bug
5.修复爆弹枪的子弹在角色中间时会消失bug
6.优化了伤害数字显示的性能
7.优化了整体帧数性能
8.修复成就解锁没给狙击枪bug
9.修复商店可能会出现没有东西卖的情况

notes.title: Optimize experience and fix bugs
notes.content:
1. Optimize the refreshing smoothness of the supply logo and supply progress bar
2. Fix the bug that the isolation shield purchased by the command tower is deployed slowly when the frame rate is unstable
3. Bosses can now push away common enemies
4. There are now upper limits on the number of elite monsters in different difficulties
5. Optimized the HP of elite monsters and bosses

notes.title: Fix bugs
notes.content:
1. Fix the bug that the car will break away from the anchor point
2. Fix the bug that the game returns to the main interface to display the wrong unlock information
3. Adjust the HP calculation method of elite monsters and bosses

notes.title: Experience optimization and bug fixes
notes.content:
Experience optimization:
1. Overall game UI optimization
2. Exit and return to the menu, keeping the last selection
3. Now there is an upper limit for the firing speed and reloading speed of each weapon
4. Optimize the performance when there are many monsters
5. Optimize the HP calculation of elite monsters and bosses
6. The unlocked reward information on the main interface is changed to display the upgrade route after clicking
7. When the gift can be unlocked with money, it will be displayed on the talent panel
8. Optimize the effects of ruins
9. When the oil barrel is exploded, it will prompt for a period of time before exploding
10. The bullet penetration of the automatic turret upgrade is related to the number of turrets present
11. At the beginning of the character, there are different numbers of upgrade slots
12. The character of the wanderer has added the feature that he can get more gold coins in a single game
13. Other optimizations

bugfix
1. Fix the bug that modifying the speed of the bullet will cause the shotgun bullet to disappear in advance
2. Fix the bug that the isolation shield cannot isolate some monsters
3. Fix the bug that the bullet cannot be changed in the car
4. Fix the bug that the damage is not displayed in the orthogonal view
5. Now the settings of BGM and sound effects will be saved in the archive
6. Fix the bug that the UI of the supply direction indication will remain
7. Other bug fixes

notes.title: Experience optimization and bug fixes
notes.content:
1. Fix the bug that the store option may get stuck
2. The oil barrel monster can be killed after transforming
3. Fix the bug that the wooden man's pocket watch skill cannot hold certain enemies
4. Adjust the value
5. Optimize performance
6. Optimize the tracking trajectory of drones to prevent drones from overlapping

notes.title: Bug fixes and experience optimization
notes.content:
1. Refresh logic has been added to the mechanical store, and now you can use money to refresh store items
2. Fixed the problem of bad files that may be caused by the gift system

notes.title: Fix bugs
notes.content:
1. Fix the bug that drones and turrets will incorrectly share talent gains
2. Optimized the experience of automatic aiming and automatic firing
3. Fixed the bug that the slots in the upgrade panel would not be refreshed in real time
4. Adjusted the upgrade parameters
5. Adjusted the monster parameters

notes.title: FixBug
notes.content:
1. Fix the bug that the target indication may be in the opposite direction under the orthogonal camera
2. Fix the bug that the joint upgrade cannot be obtained when the slot is full
3. Fix the bug that an error will be reported when the upgrade is full

notes.title: Content update and bug fixes
notes.content:
Content update:
1. The communication tower adds a command tower store, providing upgrades such as activating rail guns
2. Increase the weapon store in the game, you can buy new upgrade options
3. Now the project upgrade panel can see the upgrade route and joint upgrade items
4. Increase the slot limit for upgrade items, the default is 6 slots
5. Now after the building is destroyed, enemies may burst out or supply rewards will appear
6. Now activate the final extraction point and a boss will appear
7. A map is added to the pause interface to display the coordinates of nearby key locations
8. Now after a certain period of time, the event of "Full Infection of the City" will occur, and the number of enemies will increase significantly, and the health value will increase
9. Update the Orthogonal Angle of View option, you can switch the Orthogonal Camera Angle of View
10. Adjusted and optimized the movement speed and density of enemies
11. Adjusted the enemy's health and growth values
12. Adjusted the numerical damage of weapons and some upgrade items
13. Other optimization adjustments

bug fixes:
1. Fix the bug that the vertical drawing is still dark after purchasing the character
2. Fix the bug that the direction of the indicator arrow deviates when it is at a certain angle
3. Fix the bug of the enemy's recovery pool
4. Other bug fixes

notes.title: 2023/03/26 FixBug
notes.content:

2. Optimized the game screen
3. Fixed the problem that enemies would still be generated when pausing
4. Other experience optimization
